ofm.license_note: OFM repository has no tracked license; reused at repository owner request. Kernel retains upstream FLA attribution.

adaptations: GLA attention module uses shared scaffold RoPE and shared Block/LM/trainer, explicit per-head dimensions, blocked/fused backend names, and GLA diagnostics.
OFM associative reference exposed as standalone function returning fp32 final state.
OFM kernel bridge import points to the vendored minimal ejkernel bridge.
Kernel tile dimensions clamp to at least 16 for narrow d_K sweeps; exact dimensions remain masked.

Bridge utility file copied byte-identically; minimal package exports only triton_call. The bridge detects JAX 0.10 shard_map using public get_abstract_mesh().manual_axes, with the upstream fallback for older JAX.
runtime_notes: Set EJKERNEL_TRITON_CACHE_DIR to experiment runtime cache path.
OFM launcher disables XLA GPU command buffers with --xla_gpu_enable_command_buffer=.
The upstream bridge rejects unsharded multi-device invocations; shared runtime must invoke it per device.
